name: golf-reports
description: Pull, analyze, and render your own golf data (Arccos + GHIN + 18Birdies): strokes-gained, satellite shot maps, HTML report + PDF. Login-based, runs locally, no DevTools.

tools.name: round_stats
tools.description: Key stats for one round: SG, GIR/FW/scramble, putting, approach, peer carry.

tools.name: render_round
tools.description: Render a round to HTML report (satellite map + stats) + shot-map PDF.

tools.name: sync_arccos
tools.description: Pull the latest Arccos rounds into the local store.

tools.name: sync_ghin
tools.description: Pull the official GHIN handicap + scores.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Delete stored credentials from this machine.

GOLF_STORE.title: Data folder
GOLF_STORE.description: Where your golf data + reports are stored.

_packaging_note: DXT/MCPB schema evolves — verify against the current Desktop Extension spec before publishing (see README 'Verify on Desktop'). Bundling matplotlib for a no-Python install is the riskiest packaging step.
